points.description: States that the best-case scenario is when the input array is already sorted (in ascending/non-decreasing order). Accept 'already in order' or 'sorted array'.
points.partial_credit: No part marks: 'nearly sorted' or 'small array' does not earn this point.

points.description: States that the number of operations is N, where N is the number of elements in the array. Accept N−1 if the answer explicitly says comparisons rather than total operations.
points.partial_credit: Half credit for giving only O(N)/linear time without an exact N or N−1 count.

levels.says: Gives only O(N)/linear time, without an exact N or N−1 count.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both parts: the best case is an already sorted array, and the operation count is N (or N−1 comparisons if explicitly identified as comparisons). Award half of P2 for only O(N)/linear time. No marks for saying the best case is reverse-sorted or that the best-case count is O(N²).
